palette.notes: Measured 30 colours, 2 ramps, median hue shift 81.7 (very hue-shifted), ramp length 15. Night blues for room and city, neon pink sign, pale blue-white shirt; skin lit warm-pink against blue shadow.

lighting: Night interior: cool blue ambient from the window and city, a pink neon accent top-left, warm light on skin. Classic blue/pink cyberpunk split.
silhouette: Two figures: seated girl in front with long dark hair, standing boy behind with spiky hair and a hair dryer. Clear overlap, his arm reaching into her hair.

motion.timing: Code: 99 changes in 8.06 s, 12.3 drawings/s, hold median 83.3 ms (p25 and p75 the same), on 2.5 (about 12 fps on a 30 fps copy). Short looping action: dryer moves through her hair, her hair sways.

texture: Clean pixel art (clean_pixels true, dither 0.0016) with soft anti-aliased light on the window glass; neon has a slight glow.
camera: Static, medium shot, square framing; no camera move.
sound: Caption tags pixel music: a song loop under it.

acting.enters: No entrance; the loop starts mid-action.
acting.acts: He dries her hair, moving the dryer and lifting strands; her head turns slightly and hair sways in reply. The small give-and-take is the story.
acting.exits: No exit; loops seamlessly in 8 s.
acting.depth: Two planes of characters (her in front, him behind) plus the city far away through the window.

techniques: blue ambient + pink neon accent split
two-character interaction loop: action and reaction
hair as secondary motion reacting to the dryer
animated on 2s-3s (~12 fps) for a cozy, handmade feel
feel: night blue room + pink neon + warm skin + 12 fps two-person loop = cozy romantic moment
for_fred: Make Fred and Pixie interact in one small loop: one acts (Pixie bats at Fred), the other reacts with secondary motion (Fred's fins and tail flutter). Animate at about 12 fps on 2s-3s, keep it 4-8 s, and show them on two depth planes, one in front, one behind.
